segment.label: the active segment's folder, which the map lies on: its ink detection records find the reverse-depth twin and the labels, and its name and catalog ids feed the target rule (view itself reads only the maps and labels)

labels.label: the segment's ink labels as a TIFF on the maps' grid (an ink-labels record, or SEG_inklabels.tif in villa's naming)

page.label: one static page of the maps side by side

vc3d.label: Side-by-side page of the selected ink map and its control

facts.title: view
facts.tagline: one offline HTML page that overlays several ink maps and the labels
facts.network: None. The page loads nothing: every image is a PNG data URI inside the file
facts.success: Exit code 0 and `OUT.html` starting with `<!doctype html>`.
facts.not_a_pass: `auc_on_view` as a reported score (subsampled view, no interval, and a control only if you added the reverse map as a reader); a high rank correlation taken as correctness; any number from a map of a segment the reader trained on taken as generalization.
facts.never: Commit or share a page or PNG made from target-scroll maps (the HTML embeds the maps); commit any map-bearing HTML to this repository (no maps in git); say a letter was found or read from what the page shows.
